scope: Read-only focused review of source expressions and meanings, briefs, six keyed questions, four valid replies, and final writing models across all eight lessons. The author independently reported focused structural build/check 8/48/32/0. This report is neither a media nor a release approval.

findings.problem: The prompt asks what the speaker can tell their partner about helping their daughter. Options A and B directly address the daughter as 'you/你', while C and D answer the partner. Thus A and B are not independently valid replies to the stated listener.
findings.suggestedRepair: Recast A and B as suggestions to the partner about what the daughter may choose, with faithful Traditional Chinese, retaining four different valid replies and one target-bearing golden reply.

lessonResults.note: The fixed construction 'blow about like a weather vane' is source-backed but unusually awkward as a transferable target. Author B reports it will withdraw this provisional owner pending editorial decision.

selectionRecommendation: Keep this original eight-lesson hash unselected. Recheck revised 3656 replies and seven-lesson composition at exact final hashes; hold withdrawn 3123 separately.
